newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Lenzing says prelim jv talks with Courtaulds fail.
newsitem.headline: Lenzing says prelim jv talks with Courtaulds fail.

text.p: Austrian fibre maker Lenzing AG said on Wednesday preliminary talks with Britain's Courtaulds on a possible joint venture in the United States had ended without agreement.
But Lenzing spokeswoman Rosemarie Schuller said the Austrian firm was still open to discussion. She said the initial talks, which were not detailed, were instigated by Courtaulds.
"We are not in talks at the moment but that doesn't mean we won't take the matter up again," she told Reuters.
Lenzing's U.S. subsidiary Lenzing Fibers Corp has been plagued with losses in recent years. This year Lenzing expects the unit to repeat 1995's $10 million loss.
"We are looking at ways of improving the situation, including a cooperation," Schuller said.
Lenzing and Courtaulds are locked in a patent battle in the United States concerning a revolutionary new fibre marketed as Lyocell by Lenzing and Tencel by Courtaulds.
